RUN mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/pi-openai-compat" && \
    printf '%s' '{ \
      "previousModel": null, \
      "providers": { \
        "ollama": { \
          "displayName": "Ollama (local)", \
          "baseUrl": "http://host.docker.internal:11434/v1", \
          "apiKey": null, \
          "cachedModels": [] \
        }, \
        "openwebui": { \
          "displayName": "OpenWebUI", \
          "baseUrl": "http://host.docker.internal:3000/api/v1", \
          "apiKey": null, \
          "cachedModels": [] \
        } \
      } \
    }' > "$HOME/.config/pi-openai-compat/config.json"
description: Dockerfile that installs pi-coding-agent and pi-openai-compat, configured for non-root user with volume for Ollama host access.

steps.description: Complete pi Dockerfile with Ollama/OpenWebUI support.
Git: installed for pi to show changes before writing.
Non-root: create and switch to agent user for safety.
Ollama: add host.docker.internal to /etc/hosts and install curl and socat for connectivity.
Pi: install pi-coding-agent globally in agent's home directory.
Plugin: pi install pi-openai-compat for Ollama/OpenWebUI provider support.
